hooks.name: Resurrect the haunted example report on save
hooks.description: Scan the demo as text, never execute it. Expected findings (exit 1) count as hook success.

action.command: python -c "import sys; from satan_reborn.__main__ import main; code = main(['scan', 'examples/haunted_app', '--html', 'reports/haunted.html', '--json', 'reports/haunted.json']); sys.exit(0 if code in (0, 1) else code)"
